The same trailer was logged twice: the driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch added him by hand. Dana was handling it on our side, so I told Marcus to check with Dana for the latest status.

I didn't repeat the seat counts or the amendment from Dana's earlier message, since they weren't needed to answer.
